question: How are the vidyā and aiśa cities measured?
premises: two and two make five cities
five cities are in vidyā in four angulas
eight aiśa cities follow in four half-angulas
inference: The cities are measured in angulas according to their groups.
plain_english: Two and two make five cities in vidyā in four angulas; then eight aiśa cities follow in four half-angulas in order.
